annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires an intermediary to remove connection‑specific header fields when converting an HTTP/1.x message to HTTP/2; failure to do so results in the transformed message being treated as malformed by other HTTP/2 endpoints. The pronoun “their” refers to the messages being sent by the intermediary, and the clause does not leave any implementation‑relevant constraint unspecified.
